title: Draft a Chain of Custody
description: Complete a chain of custody form for a USB drive found at a crime scene.
problemStatement:
**Scenario:** A USB drive (brand: SanDisk, model: Ultra Fit 32GB, serial: SD12345XYZ) was found under a suspect's desk during a search warrant execution on January 15, 2026, at 10:30 AM by Detective Maria Lopez. She placed it in an anti-static bag and logged it into evidence at 10:45 AM. Later that day, at 2:00 PM, forensic examiner John Kim received the drive for imaging. He returned it to the evidence locker at 4:30 PM.

Your task is to **create a chain of custody record** that captures all required information for this drive. Use a clear tabular or descriptive format.

Include at least:
- Item description
- Initial collection entry
- Transfer to examiner entry
- Return to locker entry
- Space for date, time, signature, and purpose for each event.
hints: Use a table with columns: Item Description, Date/Time, From (person/release), To (person/receive), Purpose/Notes.
Remember to include the drive's serial number and model.
Each handover requires a new row.
expectedOutput: A complete chain of custody form with all transfer events documented.
solutionCode:
CHAIN OF CUSTODY RECORD
Case #: 2026-0115-001
Item Description: SanDisk Ultra Fit 32GB USB drive, S/N: SD12345XYZ, placed in anti-static bag.

| Date/Time          | From (Released by) | To (Received by) | Purpose / Notes                              |
|-------------------|-------------------|-----------------|---------------------------------------------|
| 2026-01-15 10:45 | Detective M. Lopez | Evidence Locker   | Seized under search warrant from suspect's desk. Placed in anti-static bag. |
| 2026-01-15 14:00 | Evidence Locker    | John Kim         | Transfer for forensic imaging.                 |
| 2026-01-15 16:30 | John Kim           | Evidence Locker   | Return after successful imaging. Hash verified. |

Each entry should be signed and dated by the individuals involved.
